---
title: "Palmer Penguins Analysis"
author: "Panav Mhatre"
format: html
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(palmerpenguins)
```

## Average Bill Length by Species

```{r}
penguins |>
  group_by(species) |>
  summarize(
    avg_bill_length = mean(bill_length_mm, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```

## Penguin Bill Length Visualization

```{r}
penguins |>
  ggplot(aes(x = species, y = bill_length_mm, fill = species)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  labs(
    title = "Penguin Bill Length by Species",
    x = "Species",
    y = "Bill Length (mm)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
